value.behaviour: Documents the two new text element fields in the file format.

sites.rule: Add a `### Styled text ranges` section, ending with a blank line. Say that a text element may carry textStyleRanges, a list of { id, seq, start, end, color?, highlight? }, with a small JSON example. Say that start and end are UTF-16 offsets into originalText, never text, with end exclusive; that at least one of color and highlight is set; that the field is absent when empty; that seq orders overlaps, so a higher seq paints over a lower one per attribute; and that id is random and holds no user data. Then say that clearedTextStyleRanges, a list of { id, seq }, records deliberately removed ranges so a stale collaborator cannot bring them back, is capped at 64 entries per element, and is also absent when empty.

value.behaviour: Documents styled ranges on skeleton text elements and labels.

sites.rule: Add a `#### With styled ranges` subsection, ending with a blank line. Show a text skeleton with textStyleRanges: [{ start: 6, end: 11, color: "#e03131", highlight: "#ffec99" }], matching the file's example style. Say that offsets index the text as given, that id and seq are optional and generated when missing, that invalid entries are dropped, and that a container's or arrow's label accepts the same field.

value.behaviour: Documents how restore treats styled ranges.

sites.rule: Add a paragraph, ending with a blank line, saying that restoreElements leaves text without textStyleRanges alone and adds no field. It clamps out-of-bounds offsets, drops malformed ranges (bad id, seq, offsets or colour value, and an id-less range), and removes the field when no range is left. It keeps id, seq and clearedTextStyleRanges, which collaboration relies on.

Add `### Partial text color and highlight (2026-11-02)`, with no PR link since no PR exists yet, then bullets, then a blank line. Bullets: text elements gain optional textStyleRanges and clearedTextStyleRanges; select text while editing and pick a color or highlight, with new clear controls; canvas draws runs and SVG export writes tspans, and lines holding RTL characters draw in the base color; restoreElements validates the field and leaves legacy text alone; reconcileElements keeps its signature and merges ranges on both outcomes; ExcalidrawElementSkeleton accepts the field on text and labels.
